name: kb_restoration_shaman
notes: The Turtle knowledge base's restoration shaman casts, added after role_healer: Chain Heal rank 3 on heavy damage and rank 1 otherwise, the max-rank Healing Wave emergency and the rank-4 top-up, the Lesser Healing Wave, Spirit Link on a dying tank. The routine entries run in band high, above role_healer's medium and light heals; the heavy-damage and tank-near-death casts in band emergency, above its own emergency heal. The narrower conditions come first, which is the one departure from the KB's numeric order.

rows.text: Totems for the group, Water Shield, mana oil | before pull
Chain Heal rank 1 | 3+ injured in a clump; the workhorse [[d:shaman#1487131843328213013]]

entries.note: The KB's rank-1 workhorse for three or more hurt members.

rows.text: Chain Heal rank 3 | heavy raid damage [[d:shaman#1472590831775912169]]

entries.note: Moved ahead of rank 1 and in band emergency (not high): the KB's heavy-damage rank would never be reached behind the rank-1 entry, and role_healer's low band outranks the high one; 'heavy' is the KB's own bot rule of three members under 50%.

rows.text: Healing Wave rank 3-4 (rank 6+ with good healing power) | single-target top-up [[d:shaman#1487131827796836525]] [[d:shaman#1464792806097682655]]

entries.note: The KB's rank 3-4 top-up: rank 4 is its upper end, the one with full scaling. 'Rank 6+ with good healing power' is gear, not a condition.

rows.text: Lesser Healing Wave (max rank) | emergency; never downrank [[d:shaman#1458535191810408539]]

entries.note: Max rank, never downranked, as the KB says.

rows.text: Ancestral Swiftness + max-rank Healing Wave | instant emergency heal [[d:shaman#1490128865564037250]]

entries.note: Moved ahead of the healing: the KB's emergency heal. Its instant comes from Ancestral Swiftness, which is self-cast and cannot read the tank's health.

rows.unexpressed: a self-cast cooldown cannot read the heal target (the heal conditions need target heal)

rows.text: Spirit Link | tank near death in a burst phase

entries.note: Moved ahead of the top-ups and in band emergency: the KB's tank-near-death cast. It is a party-targeted spell, cast here through the healer's cast path on the plan's member.
